# Subgoal: Move cyan_paper into red_bin and release
obs = observe()
zone_info = obs["zones"]["red_bin"]

# Select a viable clear candidate for cyan_paper
candidates = grasp_candidates("cyan_paper")
chosen = None
for c in candidates:
    if c.get("fingers_clear", True) and c.get("hand_clear", True):
        chosen = c
        break
if chosen is None and candidates:
    chosen = candidates[0]

# Grasp paper at a low height to reliably capture it
chosen["height"] = min(chosen.get("height", 0.015), 0.012)
res = grasp(chosen)

if res.get("holding_something", False) or observe()["gripper"]["holding_something"]:
    # Move above red_bin, clear of rim (rim_height=0.12)
    zx, zy, zz = zone_info["center"]
    rim_h = zone_info.get("rim_height", 0.12)
    carry_to(zx, zy, height=rim_h + 0.06)
    open_gripper()
    retreat(dz=0.12)
    go_home()
    check("cyan_paper", "red_bin")
